setup: custom --template render setting max_queued_tasks=0 (max_concurrent_tasks=1 already); one occupant task running, then a second POST /api/v1/videos

body.message: s11-qfull: task queue is full, please try again later

verdict: With max_queued_tasks=0 a second submit is rejected 429 'task queue is full, please try again later' (video.py L230-233, C10). With the default max_queued_tasks=100 it is accepted and silently queued at state 4/progress 0 (see S11-queue.json).
adapter_note: 429 -> retry later (bounded), NOT a task failure. The adapter must distinguish submit-429 (no task created) from a queued-200.
